### 2026-10-09 – Entry - 1

**5.5h**

Entry - 1
STARBIE PROJECTT!
I have been building the schematics for 4 days, and today I worked hard and started to build the PCB. I used ERC and solved them. At first, I was struggling and used the guide to make this. I really liked the turquoise boxes around my schematics, and now I'm excited to do my PCB design!!!
